name: Daily Follow-Up Report
query: SELECT CONCAT('', op.name, '') AS "Opportunity ID", CONCAT('', op.customer_name, '') AS "Customer", op.customer_group AS "Customer Group", fu.reason AS "Follow Up Reason", fu.time AS "Follow Up Time", fu.assigned_to AS "Assigned To", fu.notes AS "Notes" FROM `tabOpportunity` op JOIN `tabFollow Up` fu ON fu.parent = op.name WHERE DATE(fu.time) = CURDATE() ORDER BY fu.time DESC;
